hypothesis: An internally related regional parent chain can remove the source-change component of interior LOD transitions, without resolving the spatial disagreement with common terrain.
basis: Unencoded z14 GDAL area-average from immutable Swiss native source VRT, same warp contract as published Swiss z14. A coarse diagnostic basis, not the highest Swiss information level or a regeneration of fine terrain.
parents: Recursive supported-sample sum/count, float64 accumulation. Uniform Web Mercator base-cell area. Independent Terrarium encoding only for complete tiles. Partial-cell mean is diagnostic only.
support: At z14 reject nonfinite samples and cells whose corners/edge midpoints fail the inverse-LV95 source-bound test with 0.5 m guard. Parent count records complete z14 cells out of 4^(14-z). No values invented outside support; fraction is observed area support, not confidence.
rendering: H1 frozen control versus regional parents at complete z12/13 tiles, original Swiss z14-18; common elsewhere. Both use the same existing fixed presentation and source ceilings.
height: Swiss LN02 and common EGM2008 preserved. No correction, registration, transformation or blending.
metrics: Same 705 protected points; same-level full-cell comparisons and sectors; exact aggregation checks, support fractions and footprints; fixed frontier strips; separate interior and edge captures plus continuous zoom.
stopping: One chain through z10 only. No spatial reconciliation. Do not expand support, algorithms or source selection to force success. No final hierarchy contract.
limitations: Eight perimeter checks are a conservative numerical support diagnostic for this small smooth transformed rectangle, not a certified generic polygon intersection algorithm. Rejected boundary cells remain absent. Whole-tile publication can remove usable supported cells. Source grid spacing is not measurement resolution.
